summary: Datavault AI Inc. files prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 to issue 75,942,666 shares of its common stock as consideration to acquire 8,163,265 Series A Common shares of Vivasor, Inc. at $6.125 per share, implying a $50 million aggregate purchase price. The stock-for-stock transaction uses Datavault shares valued at $0.76 per share (last sale price on April 22, 2026). No underwriters or placement agents are involved; delivery expected April 23, 2026. The filing serves as the registration of shares issued in the acquisition. Watch for post-close dilution and the impact of Vivasor's business on Datavault's operations.
